一小时后，林舒离开了审讯室。

与秦朗一行人的合作关系已经正式建立，但真正说服自己的不是他们手里掌握的权力，而是他说的那最后一句话。

“我们要的东西不一样”。

如果是别人说出这句话，林舒只会怀疑，只会觉得他们道貌岸然、虚伪、轻浮。

但秦朗说出这句话的时候表情相当郑重，且眼神里透露出的，是一种坚定的自信。

他说的“我们”，并不是一个虚浮的概念。

而是实实在在的、包括他自己在内的，一个严格的定义。

他们到底想要什么？

秦朗没有给出答案，但自己其实隐约能猜到......

推门而出，那几个跟秦朗“气质相近”的工作人员都已经完成了手头的工作，正在办公室里等待。

指了指身后的林舒，秦朗开口介绍道：

“林舒，梅山派传承人，手里有真东西。”

“之后他会配合协助我们的工作，至于要不要正式加入，看他的个人选择。”

“那个......陆染，你开车送一下他。”

“现在晚了，手头的事情处理完就先回去休息，明天早上我们在林舒家里集合，看一看他那边的线索。”

“对了，那个陈竹，你们谁去跟进一下？组织上也是考察了很久才考察到她，如果能拉进来的话最好。”

“我去吧。”

坐在桌前的一个男人举起手，秦朗犹豫了一瞬，摇头道：

“算了，你别吓着人家。”

“还是陆染去吧，你待会儿送林舒回去以后就直接回来接陈竹。”

“好。”

名叫陆染的女生站起身来，林舒这时候才注意到坐在最角落的她。

戴着厚重的黑框眼镜，头发是最寻常的齐耳短发，面容算不上精致，但却带着一种独特的气质。

知识分子的气质？

林舒的脑子里突然冒出这个词来。

虽然这词在现在这时代已经不怎么用了，但有一说一，用来形容这个叫陆染的女生确实相当合适。

或者用现在更流行的话来说，她的长相大概就是那种......

智性恋看了会狂喜的长相。

“走吧。”

林舒还在愣神，陆染已经干脆利落地走了过来。

她抓起桌面上的车钥匙，带着林舒一路出门。

派出所的院子里停着一辆显然经过重度改装的丰田陆巡，两个排气管都被加高到车顶上了，也不知道这辆车平时要应付的都是什么工况。

陆染的身材不算高，感觉她上车甚至都有点费劲，但坐上主驾之后，她的动作却是熟练又从容。

“上车。”

林舒拉开副驾上了车，视线一扫而过，他看到车后座上堆着各种设备。

那些设备里有自己熟悉的香纸、朱砂、牛角、铜钱、木剑之类的“道具”，而在这些道具旁，还有几件违和感高到爆炸的“装备”。

An hour later, Lin Shu left the interrogation room.

The cooperative relationship with Qin Lang and his party has been officially established, but what really convinced him was not the power in their hands, but the last words he said.

"We want different things."

If someone else said this, Lin Shu would only be suspicious and think they were sanctimonious, hypocritical, and frivolous.

But Qin Lang's expression was quite solemn when he said this, and his eyes revealed a kind of firm confidence.

The "we" he mentioned is not a vain concept.

It is a strict definition that is real and includes himself.

What do they want?

Qin Lang didn't give an answer, but he could vaguely guess it...

Pushing the door open, several staff members with "similar temperaments" to Qin Lang had completed the work at hand and were waiting in the office.

Pointing to Lin Shu behind him, Qin Lang introduced:

"Lin Shu, the successor of Meishan Sect, has something real in his hands."

"He will cooperate and assist us in our work from now on. As for whether he wants to formally join, it depends on his personal choice."

"Um...Lu Ran, please drive him off."

"It's too late now. After handling the matters at hand, go back and rest. We will meet at Lin Shu's house tomorrow morning to take a look at his clues."

"By the way, Chen Zhu, who among you will follow up? The organization also investigated her for a long time before they found her. It would be best if she could be brought in."

"I'll go."

A man sitting at the table raised his hand. Qin Lang hesitated for a moment, shook his head and said:

"Forget it, don't scare people."

"It's better for Lu Ran to go. After you send Lin Shu back later, you can come back directly to pick up Chen Zhu."

"Okay."

The girl named Lu Ran stood up, and only then did Lin Shu notice her sitting in the corner.

Wearing thick black-rimmed glasses, his hair is the most common ear-length short hair, his face is not exquisite, but he has a unique temperament.

Intellectual temperament?

This word suddenly popped into Lin Shu's mind.

Although this word is not commonly used in this era, there is a saying that it is indeed quite suitable to describe this girl named Lu Ran.

Or to use more popular words nowadays, she probably looks like that...

The sapiosexual looked at the ecstatic appearance.

"Let's go."

Lin Shu was still stunned, but Lu Ran had already walked over neatly.

She grabbed the car keys on the table and took Lin Shu out.

Parked in the yard of the police station was a Toyota Land Cruiser that had obviously been heavily modified. The two exhaust pipes were raised to the roof of the car. It was unknown what kind of working conditions this car usually had to deal with.

Lu Ran was not tall, and it felt like it was a bit difficult for her to get into the car, but after sitting in the driver's seat, her movements were skillful and calm.

"Get in the car."

Lin Shu pulled the co-pilot and got into the car. Looking across the car, he saw various equipment piled on the back seat of the car.

Among the equipment were familiar "props" such as incense paper, cinnabar, horns, copper coins, and wooden swords. Next to these props, there were several pieces of "equipment" that were so inconsistent that they were explosive.
